verdict.rationale: Synonyms are documented first-party: Meilisearch lets you define lists of equivalent words to improve relevance. Result curation is only claimed on the pricing page as 'Dynamic Search Rules' to boost, pin, or bury results based on request context, with no technical documentation behind it and possible paid-tier gating. Customizable ranking-rule order is documented as general relevance tuning, but it is not per-query curation. Missing for 10: documentation of pin/boost rules tied to specific queries, explicit hide/exclude capability (bury is not hide), clarity on plan availability, and independent or hands-on corroboration of curation.
